checks.instruction: Final acceptance: inspect the master project in Remotion Studio and the resulting exported MP4 (image, transitions/scene changes, authored audio/video) and confirm it matches the mental model of one Remotion video project while the existing Jarvis presentation path remains available.
checks.prerequisite: The user restarts their own Jarvis on branch task/jarvis-remotion-master-project-studio-export themselves; no agent starts, restarts or stops it. No migration (no _SCHEMA_VERSION change in d101d887..HEAD), no new environment variable. Do HV-RMP-05-01, 07-01 and 08-01 first or together.
evidence: evidence/release-studio-summary.json + studio-master.png (master Studio from Variants, 4 scenes, scenes 1-4 seen)

evidence/release-export-summary.json + boundaries.png + export-done.png (one MP4 1920x1080 30/1, 150 frames, h264 + aac; frames before/after each boundary = expected scene at local 0 / last frame; audio -18.3 dBFS in the <Audio> scene, silence after)
evidence/legacy-summary.json + legacy-variants.png (mixed-fps deck: master refused with its sentence, Lire plays, scene Studio and scene export work)
evidence/core-outage.png, throwing-scene.png and the injections block of the summaries (no canonical file changed)
evidence/trace-t2/ (real voice-path trace on the release head)

checklist.step: Open a master-ready deck that has at least one scene with sound or video (ask Jarvis for one with a short background sound if needed). « Remotion Studio » → confirm → in Remotion Studio, play `JarvisPresentation` from start to end.
checklist.look_at: One project, one composition, every scene in order in one timeline, each scene starting at its own start; nothing in Studio suggests « one slide ».

checklist.step: « Exporter la vidéo », then « Ouvrir la vidéo » and watch it with sound on the target machine (and the projector if used for presentations).
checklist.look_at: Image quality; each scene change clean (no black, white or mixed frame, no scene cut short at a score target); authored audio heard at the right moments; authored video clips play; duration = sum of the scenes.
checklist.record: pass/fail per scene change, any defect with its time code

checklist.step: On the same deck and on an older mixed-fps deck: « Lire », « Présenter », « Cette scène seule dans Remotion Studio » → edit → « Publier dans la variante… », and a scene export from the Board's Artifacts.
checklist.look_at: Everything that worked before this task still works; the older deck says why the whole video is not available and keeps the scene door.

checklist.step: Read REPORT.md § 7 (residual risks: R1 Studio line during a Core outage, R2 browser-launch label, R3 retry after a scene error and cut code line, Issues 01-03, textual detections, 9000-frame cap).
checklist.look_at: Decide which are acceptable for release and which you want as follow-up tasks. Issue 03 (explorer autoplay lost by the d101d887 merge into main) needs your decision: port it or retire its test.
